nameForm.fullText: William Durham and Mahala Songo Durham

note.text: Evidence: Isabella married Isaiah Durham in Smyrna DE. The minister was William R. McFarlane. Isaiah is believed to have been the son of William Durham and Mahala Songo Durham. Mahala married William H. Morgan
